panels.description: Wind speed forecast at ${height_m} m. wind_nbm values are converted from m/s to knots and filtered to the most recent startdt at-or-before the 'From' time (within 6 h).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  windspdmean,
  windspdlb,
  windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))

    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'

      AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  windspdmean AS windspdmean,
  windspdlb AS windspdlb,
  windspdub AS windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data

      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = '$group'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS "time",
    winddirmean,
    winddirlb,
    winddirub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    forecastdtutc AS "time",
    winddirmean,
    winddirlb,
    winddirub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
)
SELECT w."time",
       w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean, w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1, w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_s0)) END AS winddirlb, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sm1)) END AS winddirlb_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sp1)) END AS winddirlb_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_s0)) END AS winddirub, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sm1)) END AS winddirub_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sp1)) END AS winddirub_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_s0)) END AS winddirbandlb, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sm1)) END AS winddirbandlb_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sp1)) END AS winddirbandlb_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_s0)) END AS winddirbandub, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sm1)) END AS winddirbandub_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sp1)) END AS winddirbandub_sp1
FROM public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"      ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirlb   ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirub   ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w
ORDER BY w."time"

panels.description: Observed vs forecast wind speed at ${height_m} m. Three series: ensemble mean (windspdmean), NBM forecast (windspd), and observed wind speed from model_1 fhr=0 rows (or wind_nbm fhr=0 rows for wind_nbm groups).

targets.rawSql:
WITH legacy AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS "time",
         windspdmean,
         windspd AS windspd_nbm
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
), nbm_run AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         windspdmean,
         windspd AS windspd_nbm
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
), obs_legacy AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         obs_wspd_kt AS windspd_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    AND fhr = 0
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND model = 'model_1'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), obs_nbm AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         obs_wspd_kt AS windspd_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    AND fhr = 0
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND model = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), u AS (
  SELECT "time", windspdmean, windspd_nbm, NULL::float AS windspd_obs FROM legacy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", windspdmean, windspd_nbm, NULL::float AS windspd_obs FROM nbm_run
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", NULL::float, NULL::float, windspd_obs FROM obs_legacy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", NULL::float, NULL::float, windspd_obs FROM obs_nbm
)
SELECT "time",
       MAX(windspdmean) AS windspdmean,
       MAX(windspd_nbm) AS windspd_nbm,
       MAX(windspd_obs) AS windspd_obs
FROM u
GROUP BY "time"
ORDER BY "time"

WITH legacy AS (

      FROM forecast_data

        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))

), nbm_run AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         winddirmean,
         winddir AS winddir_nbm
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
), obs_legacy AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         obs_wdir_degrees AS winddir_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    AND fhr = 0
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND model = 'model_1'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), obs_nbm AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         obs_wdir_degrees AS winddir_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    AND fhr = 0
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND model = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), u AS (
  SELECT "time", winddirmean, winddir_nbm, NULL::float AS winddir_obs FROM legacy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", winddirmean, winddir_nbm, NULL::float AS winddir_obs FROM nbm_run
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", NULL::float, NULL::float, winddir_obs FROM obs_legacy

), src AS (
  SELECT "time",
         MAX(winddirmean) AS winddirmean,
         MAX(winddir_nbm) AS winddir_nbm,

SELECT w."time",
       w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean, w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1, w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
       w.v2_s0 AS winddir_nbm, w.v2_sm1 AS winddir_nbm_sm1, w.v2_sp1 AS winddir_nbm_sp1,
       w.v3_s0 AS winddir_obs, w.v3_sm1 AS winddir_obs_sm1, w.v3_sp1 AS winddir_obs_sp1
FROM public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"     ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddir_nbm ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddir_obs ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w
ORDER BY w."time"

panels.title: Observed vs. Forecast Wind Direction (${height_m} m)

panels.description: Latest wind speed per location and available height.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  locname AS "Location",
  COALESCE(height_m, 20) AS "Height (m)",
  timestamp AS "Last Updated",
  windspdmean AS "Wind Speed"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20))
    locname,
    height_m,
    timestamp,
    windspdmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20), timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
) sub
ORDER BY locname, "Height (m)"

panels.title: Wind Speed by Location and Height
Bias (forecast − observed)
panels.description: Mean signed error over the selected window. Positive = over-forecasting visibility (i.e. forecast is clearer than observed).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(error) AS bias
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

panels.title: MAE
panels.description: Mean absolute error. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(ABS(error)) AS mae
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

panels.title: RMSE
panels.description: Root mean squared error. Penalises large errors more than MAE.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SQRT(AVG(error*error)) AS rmse
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

panels.title: Sample N
panels.description: Number of matched (forecast, observation) pairs in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

panels.title: Obs inside ensemble envelope
panels.description: Fraction of observations falling between vislb and visub. ~80–90% is a well-calibrated ensemble for nominal 80%/90% bounds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(in_envelope::float) AS pct_inside
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND forecast_lb IS NOT NULL
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       AVG(error)        AS "Bias",
       AVG(ABS(error))   AS "MAE"
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       lead_bucket AS metric,
       AVG(ABS(error)) AS mae
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT lead_bucket, COUNT(*)::bigint AS n
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Forecast vs Observed (scatter)
panels.description: Each point is a matched (forecast, observation) pair. Both axes capped at 5 nmi. Perfect forecasts fall on the y=x diagonal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_value, forecast_capped
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
SELECT g::float AS identity_x, g::float AS identity_y FROM generate_series(0, 5, 0.1) g

panels.title: Hits / Misses / False alarms / Correct negatives @ 1.5 nmi
panels.description: Contingency counts using vis ≤ 1.5 nmi as the event threshold. Phase 2 will turn these into POD / FAR / CSI / HSS.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN forecast_capped <= 1.5 AND observed_value <= 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Hits",
  SUM(CASE WHEN forecast_capped >  1.5 AND observed_value <= 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Misses",
  SUM(CASE WHEN forecast_capped <= 1.5 AND observed_value >  1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "False alarms",
  SUM(CASE WHEN forecast_capped >  1.5 AND observed_value >  1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Correct negatives"
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'visibility'
  AND model = 'fog_1'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

panels.title: Visibility verification — Mean vs Median forecast
panels.description: Same matched forecast/observation pairs as the visibility headline metrics, but reports stats for both the ensemble mean (vismean) and the ensemble median (vismedian) forecasts. Visibility values are capped at 5 nmi on both sides of the difference.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fcst AS (
  SELECT "timestamp", group_id, locid, locname, startdt,
         LEAST(vismean,   5.0) AS f_mean,
         LEAST(vismedian, 5.0) AS f_median,
         CASE
           WHEN startdt IS NULL                                    THEN 'astro'
           WHEN "timestamp" - startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours'       THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN "timestamp" - startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours'      THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN "timestamp" - startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours'      THEN '12-24h'
           WHEN "timestamp" - startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours'      THEN '24-48h'
           WHEN "timestamp" - startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours'      THEN '48-72h'
           ELSE '72h+'
         END AS lead_bucket
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE model = 'fog_1'
    AND vismean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND locname  = '$location'
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
), obs AS (
  SELECT group_id, locid, locname, "timestamp", LEAST(obsvis, 5.0) AS o_val
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE model = 'model_1' AND fhr = 0 AND obsvis IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group' AND locname = '$location'
), j AS (
  SELECT f.lead_bucket, f.f_mean, f.f_median, o.o_val,
         (f.f_mean   - o.o_val) AS err_mean,
         (f.f_median - o.o_val) AS err_median
  FROM fcst f
  JOIN obs o
    ON o.group_id = f.group_id AND o.locid = f.locid
   AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
  WHERE f.lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
)
SELECT 'Mean'   AS "Forecast statistic",
       COUNT(*)                                AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                           AS "Bias (nmi)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))                      AS "MAE (nmi)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean))          AS "RMSE (nmi)"
FROM j
WHERE f_mean IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Median',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_median IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_median),
       AVG(ABS(err_median)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_median * err_median))
FROM j
WHERE f_median IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Wind speed metrics
panels.description: Bias = AVG(forecast − observed); MAE = AVG(|error|); RMSE = sqrt(AVG(error^2)); In-envelope = fraction of observations between windspdlb and windspdub. The 'Ensemble mean' row uses windspdmean; the 'NBM' row uses the windspd column (NBM forecast). Observations come from model_1 / wind_nbm fhr=0 rows at the same valid time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
      ELSE '72h+'
    END AS lead_bucket,
    f.windspdmean AS forecast_mean,
    f.windspd     AS forecast_nbm,
    f.windspdlb   AS forecast_lb,
    f.windspdub   AS forecast_ub,
    o.obs_wspd_kt AS observed_value
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 20) = 10
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 20) = 10
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
), errors AS (
  SELECT lead_bucket,
         observed_value,
         forecast_lb, forecast_ub,
         forecast_mean - observed_value AS err_mean,
         forecast_nbm  - observed_value AS err_nbm
  FROM matched
  WHERE observed_value IS NOT NULL
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
)
SELECT 'Ensemble mean' AS "Source",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_mean IS NOT NULL) AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                    AS "Bias (kt)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))               AS "MAE (kt)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean))   AS "RMSE (kt)",
       AVG(CASE WHEN observed_value BETWEEN forecast_lb AND forecast_ub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
         FILTER (WHERE forecast_lb IS NOT NULL AND forecast_ub IS NOT NULL) AS "In-envelope"
FROM errors
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NBM',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_nbm IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_nbm),
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_nbm * err_nbm)),
       NULL::float
FROM errors

panels.title: Wind direction metrics
panels.description: Direction error uses shortest signed angular difference, so ±180 deg is the largest possible miss. The 'Ensemble mean' row uses winddirmean; the 'NBM' row uses the winddir column (NBM forecast). Observations come from model_1 / wind_nbm fhr=0 rows at the same valid time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN '24-48h'
      WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '72 hours' THEN '48-72h'
      ELSE '72h+'
    END AS lead_bucket,
    f.winddirmean AS forecast_mean,
    f.winddir     AS forecast_nbm,
    o.obs_wdir_degrees AS observed_value
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wdir_degrees
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 20) = 10
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.winddirmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = '$group'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 20) = 10
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
), errors AS (
  SELECT lead_bucket,
         (MOD((forecast_mean - observed_value + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float AS err_mean,
         (MOD((forecast_nbm  - observed_value + 540)::numeric, 360) - 180)::float AS err_nbm
  FROM matched
  WHERE observed_value IS NOT NULL
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
)
SELECT 'Ensemble mean' AS "Source",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_mean IS NOT NULL) AS "N",
       AVG(err_mean)                  AS "Circular bias (deg)",
       AVG(ABS(err_mean))             AS "MAE (deg)",
       SQRT(AVG(err_mean * err_mean)) AS "RMSE (deg)"
FROM errors
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NBM',
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE err_nbm IS NOT NULL),
       AVG(err_nbm),
       AVG(ABS(err_nbm)),
       SQRT(AVG(err_nbm * err_nbm))
FROM errors

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (

           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '0-6h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
           WHEN f."timestamp" - f.startdt <= INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '12-24h'

           ELSE '72h+'
         END AS lead_bucket,
         COALESCE(o.obs_wspd_kt, o.windspd, f.windspd) AS speed_obs,
         COALESCE(o.obs_wdir_degrees, o.winddir, f.winddir) AS direction_obs
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt, o.obs_wdir_degrees, o.windspd, o.winddir
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname

      AND o.fhr = 0

    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$model'
    AND COALESCE(f.height_m, 20) = 10
    AND $__timeFilter(f."timestamp")
)
SELECT lead_bucket AS "Lead bucket",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed_obs IS NOT NULL) AS "Wind speed pairs",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_obs IS NOT NULL) AS "Wind direction pairs"
FROM base
WHERE lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(height_m, 20) AS height_m FROM forecast_data WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL AND locname = '$location' AND group_id = '$group' ORDER BY height_m ASC
list.name: height_m
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(height_m, 20) AS height_m FROM forecast_data WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL AND locname = '$location' AND group_id = '$group' ORDER BY height_m ASC
list.label: Height (m)

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT lead_bucket FROM v_forecast_verification WHERE variable = 'visibility' ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN 'astro' THEN 0 WHEN '0-6h' THEN 1 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 2 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 3 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 4 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 5 WHEN '72h+' THEN 6 ELSE 9 END
list.name: lead_bucket

list.label: Lead-time bucket

list.definition: SELECT to_char(MAX(timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI" UTC"') FROM forecast_data WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL AND locname = '$location' AND group_id = '$group' AND model = '$model' AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
